en-US.longDescription: If you are to look for a way to co-work with your colleagues in your company, Netpas Tramper Business is the perfect solution for you. All the data (estimations, operations, vessel list, contract, address book) is saved in one place to be shared and edited by the users in your organization. Its powerful tools such as Contract Manager, Address Book and Vessel Manager will help your main workflow from Estimation to Operation and Balancing. You can set the different access permission to each menu/folder and each users with Tramper Business Admin function, and see the statistics on your revenue and profit of your operation with various chart options.
en-US.name: Netpas Tramper Business

zh-CN.description: 通过 Tramper Business 协同工作
zh-CN.longDescription: 若您正在寻找与公司同事协同工作的解决方案，Netpas Tramper Business 将是您的理想之选。所有数据（包括估算、运营、船舶列表、合同及通讯录）均集中存储，可供组织内成员共享与编辑。其强大的功能模块——合同管理器、通讯录及船舶管理器——将贯穿您从成本估算到运营结算的核心工作流程。通过 Tramper Business 管理员功能，您可为不同菜单/文件夹及用户设置差异化权限，并通过多样化图表查看运营收入与利润的统计分析。
